context_zh: 研究方法课使用完全假设的纸上模型，学生讨论报告的证据限制，而非提供现实工程结论。

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Can our conclusion say the model's validity has been established?

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: No. This is still a theoretical model; we haven't tested it.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: And temperature is a variable we haven't included at all.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Then we should describe the result as a prediction to check, not a confirmed finding.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I'll rewrite that sentence and list the missing variable in the limitations.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Yes. The proposed test can stay in the next-steps section.
